items.claim: Estevan Rubiks is not a top 15 level guy.
items.quote: Estevan's not a top 15 level guy.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern hasn't fought since October of 2025.
items.quote: She hasn't fought since October of 2025.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has been dealing with injuries.
items.quote: I think she's been dealing with injuries

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has lost to Amanda Lemos and Jessica Andrade.
items.quote: She's lost to Amanda Lemos. She's lost to Jessica Andrade.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson is a better grappler than Mackenzie Dern.
items.quote: Gillian Robertson, I'd say is a better grappler than Mackenzie Dern.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has better BJJ and is a little bit more dangerous than Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: I think Mackenzie Dern's got better better BJJ and is a little bit more dangerous.

items.claim: Ian Garry has no KO or finishing threat.
items.quote: there is no KO or finishing threat from Garry.

items.claim: Ian Garry's last finish was back in 2022 against Daniel Rodriguez.
items.quote: The last finish this guy had, I think, was back in 2022 against Daniel Rodriguez.

items.claim: Ian Garry lost to Shavkat Rakhmonov and got outstruck and outgrappled.
items.quote: Garry's already lost to a grappler in Shavkat, and he got outstruck. The one decent grappler that Garry's faced in in Shavkat Rakhmonov, he got outgrappled, but like he also got outstruck by.

items.claim: Ian Garry is much rangier and bigger than any opponent Islam Makhachev has faced.
items.quote: Ian is so much more rangier and bigger than any Makhachev opponent.

items.claim: Ian Garry has elite fight IQ.
items.quote: he's got elite fight IQ, some of the best in the game.
